title: Repo: /home/n3o/code/aura-harness (Rust workspace). Read-only investigation.
summary: I traced every path below, but changed nothing and ran no tests. The cause is simple: nothing in a compare request differs between arms. There is no per-run marker anywhere in the request and no cache key, and both arms use the same credentials, so Anthropic serves B the prefixes A wrote. Beyond the provider cache, the main thing the arms share is Gate's routing table, which updates live from eve…
